verdict.rationale: Digits documents an API reference indexed in llms.txt, an OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a resettable developer sandbox. None of the evidence describes an interactive reference with in-browser 'try it' or runnable examples. The spec and sandbox are building blocks or adjacent features, not the interactive explorer the story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
